# HAUTLAB

Canonical site: https://www.hautlabmx.com
Location: Mérida, Yucatán, México

HAUTLAB is a private medical practice in Mérida focused on clinical dermatology, medical aesthetics and facial treatment planning.

## Editorial principles

Clinical pages are informational and do not replace an individual medical evaluation. Diagnosis, treatment selection, procedural indication and risk assessment depend on the patient's history and examination. HAUTLAB does not claim that every patient is a candidate for a procedure.
